environment.description: Same Go microservice on EKS v1.27 in namespace 'services'. Calico CNI with GlobalNetworkPolicy 'deny-metadata-cidr' applied at priority 100 matching selector projectcalico.org/namespace == 'services', denying egress to CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 on port 80 (protocol TCP). Additionally, a namespace-scoped Kubernetes NetworkPolicy 'restrict-egress-link-local' with spec.podSelector matchLabels app: metadata-svc, policyTypes [Egress], egress rules allowing only DNS (UDP/53 to kube-system) and internal cluster CIDR 10.0.0.0/8. Note: the Kubernetes NetworkPolicy alone would block metadata access, but the Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy provides defense-in-depth at the dataplane level regardless of pod label mutations. IMDSv1 remains enabled on nodes.
